page_title: CAG 3-3 GEN | Cagliari v Genoa 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Cuenca Martinez H. F. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The manager won't be happy after Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) receives another yellow card and is sent off.
90+1' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Here is a change. Lorenzo Colombo is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa).
88' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
87' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
86' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is punished with the yellow card.
83' 3 - 3 GOAL! The mid-range free kick from Aaron Martin (Genoa) somehow evades the defence and goalie and finds its way into the back of net! No way he meant that but the score is now 3:3.
83' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) receives a yellow card.
82' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Genoa.
79' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
78' Here comes a substitution. Valentin Carboni (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Alessandro Marcandalli.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha leaves the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on.
76' Alessandro Deiola is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Pisacane sends Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) on the pitch.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
72' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
71' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) replacing Sebastiano Esposito.
71' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Gennaro Borrelli is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
68' Albert Gronbaek (Genoa) gets a yellow card.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Albert Gronbaek (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Morten Thorsby can be given a rest.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is adjudged offside.
64' Great teamplay by Genoa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

60' 3 - 2 It's a goal! Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) makes it 3:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Gabriele Zappa and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Nicola Leali was helpless.
57' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Matteo Prati will be replaced by Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
57' Mattia Felici will be replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).
55' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
53' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico La Penna blows for a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick.
52' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is intercepted by Elia Caprile.
51' Genoa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' It's like he was asking for a caution. Matteo Prati (Cagliari) receives a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Federico La Penna blows his whistle for an infringement. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
44' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) receives a yellow card!

43' 2 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
43' Federico La Penna sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
43' Wait! Referee Federico La Penna has indicated he is going to review the Genoa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
41' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Morten Thorsby plays it into the box, and Leo Ostigard (Genoa) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the right post. 1:2.
41' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
39' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the corner with a short pass.

37' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) blows a golden opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounces on the rebound to head the ball just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
36' Referee Federico La Penna sees the trip by Morten Thorsby (Genoa) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

33' 1 - 1 Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) strikes with a perfect low header inside the left post after a brilliant cross! He found himself unmarked and nodded the ball past the goalkeeper. Brilliant finish!
33' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes a short corner kick.
31' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
29' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
25' A fine pass finds Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Elia Caprile reacts superbly to deny him.
25' Vitinha (Genoa) commits a foul and Federico La Penna immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
24' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
23' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
23' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
22' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.

18' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Vitinha (Genoa). Lorenzo Colombo plays a fantastic through ball and finds Vitinha (Genoa), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the left side of the goal. It's now 0:1.
18' A pass by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) jumps into a tackle and Federico La Penna signals a foul.
13' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
11' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Vitinha, but Elia Caprile displays great awareness to stop him.
9' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) picks up a caution.

9' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
9' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
9' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) gets inside the box and tries to beat Elia Caprile with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
8' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul after Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Genoa.

6' High and wide! Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
5' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Federico La Penna blows for a foul. Cagliari get a free kick.
4' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Federico La Penna will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
